post.summary: Find events in a date range, for the AI

schema.description: Makes the call safe to repeat (1-100 characters: letters, digits, `_`, `-`). The same key for the same action returns the first result without running it again (response header `Idempotent-Replayed: true`); for another action it is refused with 422. Keys are kept 7 days.

parameters.description: Makes the call safe to repeat (1-100 characters: letters, digits, `_`, `-`). The same key for the same action returns the first result without running it again (response header `Idempotent-Replayed: true`); for another action it is refused with 422. Keys are kept 7 days.
parameters.name: idempotency-key

from.description: First day, YYYY-MM-DD; required unless `text` is given (then it defaults to today). Without `to` and `text` it means that one day

to.description: Last day (inclusive), YYYY-MM-DD; at most 62 days after `from`; with `text` it defaults to 62 days after `from`

text.description: Only events whose title or place contains this text or a form of its words ("swimming" also finds "Swim training"), e.g. "swimming". Without `from` and `to` it searches from today on

members.description: Leave it out (the default) for the whole family calendar: overviews and "what is on" questions, also when the person says "give me" or "show me" (that is who gets the answer, not whose events). Only for a question about specific people's own events ("my calendar", "what do I have", "am I free", "Noah's week"): what involves these people, plus events for the whole family

tag.description: Only events with this existing family tag; leave out unless a tag was named

200.description: Applied, or stored as a draft for approval

id.description: The event, for changing or deleting it; null for subscribed calendars

occurrence.description: Repeating events only: the key of this date, for changing or deleting only that one

time.description: HH:MM-HH:MM local time; null for all-day events

memberIds.description: Left out means the whole family

external.description: Only on events from a subscribed calendar

when.description: Only for today and what is on now. past: already over; now: happening now (or today, all day); upcoming: still ahead. Other days are before or after today by their date

id.description: The event; null for subscribed calendars

nextMatch.description: Only when nothing matched in the range: the next match after it

422.description: The Idempotency-Key was used for a different action

tags.description: Short labels. Reuse one of the family's existing tags when it fits instead of inventing a new one; at most 2.
